title: Regular sequence on the closed fibre of a flat local homomorphism
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m)$ and $(S,\mathfrak n)$ be Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] (commutative rings with exactly one maximal ideal, $\mathfrak m$ resp. $\mathfrak n$) and $\varphi:R\to S$ a ring homomorphism which is local ($\varphi(\mathfrak m)\subseteq\mathfrak n$) and flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Let $\mathfrak mS$ be the ideal of $S$ generated by $\varphi(\mathfrak m)$, let $c\ge0$ and $f_1,\dots,f_c\in S$, and suppose that the images $\bar f_1,\dots,\bar f_c$ of the $f_j$ in $S/\mathfrak mS$ form a regular sequence in the ring $S/\mathfrak mS$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Then $f_1,\dots,f_c$ is a regular sequence in $S$, and for every $0\le i\le c$ the quotient $S/(f_1,\dots,f_i)S$, an $R$-module via $\varphi$, is a flat $R$-module.
